description: Text input for composing a comment or reply, with @-mention autocomplete that filters a user list as you type, keyboard navigation of suggestions, and chips summarizing the selected mentions before submit.

parameters.name: AutoFocus
parameters.description: Whether to show a cancel button.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Callback invoked when editing is canceled.

parameters.name: MentionUsers
parameters.description: Whether Enter submits the composer when mention selection is not open. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the text is submitted.

parameters.name: OnSubmit
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the selected mention list changes.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the text changes.

parameters.name: SubmitOnEnter
parameters.description: Whether the textarea should request focus when rendered.
